goal: Fuzz test the URI query parameter parser used by REST endpoints against crashes and edge cases
Protects against malformed, unauthenticated client inputs causing parser bugs
agreement: Verified by testing after resolving a concern about keys following fragment separators (nervana21)

categories.name: tests
why: P3 because it adds fuzz coverage for untrusted REST query string parsing to catch edge-case parser crashes
Targets a low-traffic REST helper rather than high-risk subsystems like consensus or P2P
